candidates: The feature fires on punctuation immediately before LaTeX/math content, especially colon or comma right before a `$...$` span or a TeX control sequence.

The feature detects boundary formatting around highly symbolic tokens: punctuation such as comma/colon placed directly before TeX/math expressions, and more weakly before other symbolic literals like hex constants.
A narrower subfeature may fire on delimiter tokens themselves at the start or edge of symbolic spans, especially `$` and punctuation+backslash sequences like `,\\`.
